patches.title: Skip Non-Storage Furniture
patches.principle: Avoid examining shelves, towel holders, or decorative items until all countertops, cabinets, and drawers are searched.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and you have not exhausted storage furniture.

patches.title: After Placement Continue Search
patches.principle: After placing one of multiple objects, search new surfaces and containers for the remaining objects instead of returning to the previous location.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have placed one object in a task that requires multiple placements.

patches.title: Avoid Immediate Re-pickup
patches.principle: Once an object is placed at its valid destination, do not pick it up again; proceed to the next required action.
patches.when_to_apply: After successfully placing an object at the intended location.
